# Billing

Northwind Care is sold as a yearly subscription. The Standard plan costs 49 EUR
per year and the Business plan costs 129 EUR per year. Both include firmware
updates for the life of the device.

## Refunds

You can cancel a Northwind Care subscription and request a full refund within
30 days of purchase. Refunds are paid back to the original payment method and
take up to two weeks to appear.

## Invoices

Invoices are issued on the day the subscription renews and can be downloaded from
the account area. We do not send paper invoices.
